proposed.text: A one-storey building contains a convenience store and a barber shop (both Group E) with no fire separation. Under Sec. 703, which rule applies?

options.text: The most restrictive occupancy (Group E) governs the entire building, ensuring compliance with the highest safety standards applicable.
Each portion may be treated under its own occupancy requirements because the building is one storey
The larger occupancy (convenience store) governs because it exceeds 10% of total area, which is a common threshold for determining primary use.
The building must be reclassified as Group H because it serves the public, which is a misinterpretation of occupancy classification rules.
